name: PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator
description: Multi-process PDFium rendering for PdfiumRaster with bounded scheduling, crash isolation, hard timeouts, and local named-pipe communication.
description_good_justification: The project purpose and scope are documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator#pdfiumrasterorchestrator.
interact_justification: Installation, support, security reporting, and contribution paths are linked from https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator#project-community.
contribution_justification: The contribution workflow is documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md.
contribution_requirements_justification: Coding, compatibility, testing, documentation, review, and release requirements are documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md.
floss_license_justification: The project is released under the MIT license at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/LICENSE.
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is an OSI-approved open-source license.
license_location_justification: The license is in the repository root at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/LICENSE.
documentation_basics_justification: Installation, secure deployment limitations, usage, and operational behavior are documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/README.md.
documentation_interface_justification: The public interface is documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/docs/API.md and in generated XML documentation included in the NuGet package.
sites_https_justification: The source repository, documentation, issue tracker, and NuGet distribution endpoints use HTTPS.
discussion_justification: Public support and design discussion use GitHub issues as documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/SUPPORT.md.
english_justification: Project documentation, issue templates, and contribution guidance are available in English.
maintained_justification: Maintenance policy and supported versions are documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/SUPPORT.md, with current development visible in the repository history.
repo_track_justification: The Git repository retains the public history for project changes.
repo_interim_justification: Development changes are committed between versioned releases in the public Git repository.
repo_distributed_justification: The project uses Git, a distributed version-control system.
version_unique_justification: Every published package release has a unique version recorded in https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md.
version_semver_justification: Releases use Semantic Versioning as documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/docs/RELEASING.md.
version_tags_justification: Release tags use the package version, as documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/docs/RELEASING.md.
release_notes_justification: Versioned release notes are maintained at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md.
report_process_justification: The issue-reporting process is documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/SUPPORT.md and implemented with structured GitHub issue forms.
report_tracker_justification: Public defects and feature proposals are tracked in https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/issues.
report_archive_justification: GitHub permanently archives public issue and pull-request discussions at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/issues.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The vulnerability reporting and coordinated disclosure process is documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/security/policy.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private reports use GitHub private security advisories through https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/security/advisories/new.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: Acknowledgement and initial-assessment targets are documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/security/policy.
build_justification: The one-command build and release targets are documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/Makefile.
build_common_tools_justification: The project uses the standard .NET SDK and a root Makefile.
build_floss_tools_justification: The .NET SDK, MSBuild, Git, and GNU Make-compatible tooling used by the build are open source.
test_justification: The automated test suite is maintained under https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/tree/master/tests.
test_invocation_justification: The complete automated suite runs with make test as documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/docs/TESTING.md.
test_most_justification: The enforced application-library coverage floor is 90% lines and 80% branches, documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/docs/TESTING.md.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Tests run on Linux, Windows, and macOS for pushes and pull requests through https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/actions/workflows/ci.yml.
test_policy_justification: The contribution policy requires focused tests for changed behavior at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md.
tests_are_added_justification: Pull requests must add focused tests for new or changed behavior, as required by https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md.
tests_documented_added_justification: Test additions and the behavioral coverage matrix are documented at https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/blob/master/docs/TESTING.md.
warnings_justification: Release builds enable nullable analysis and the Microsoft public API analyzer; CodeQL provides additional static analysis.
warnings_fixed_justification: The contribution workflow requires a clean build and passing static analysis before merge.
delivery_mitm_justification: Packages are distributed over HTTPS through https://www.nuget.org/packages/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL runs for pushes, pull requests, and weekly scheduled analysis through https://github.com/gabisonia/PdfiumRaster.Orchestrator/actions/workflows/codeql.yml.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Static-analysis findings are published in GitHub code scanning and must be resolved or explicitly assessed before release.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and pull request to the default branch and on a weekly schedule.
